hints.title: Gray Code Correspondence
hints.text: The allowable bit operations match transitions in binary reflected Gray code.

hints.title: Inverse Gray Mapping
hints.text: Transforming an integer to zero requires finding its index in the Gray code sequence.

hints.title: Prefix XOR Cumulative Fold
hints.text: Compute the inverse Gray code by XORing n with itself repeatedly right shifted by powers of two.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Breadth-first search over bit transitions visits up to 2^30 states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Inverse Gray code conversion runs in O(log n) bitwise operations using O(1) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies algebraic Gray code structure or formulates recursive relation.
